security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A companion dashboard for a secondary display.
bundle.longDescription: Kehai is a dashboard for a small always-on secondary display. A Rust integration engine polls system telemetry, media, notifications and local agent token usage on background threads; the renderer lays widgets out on a configurable grid. Everything is read locally and nothing is sent anywhere.
